name: Chest Radiograph
desc: A posteroanterior chest X-ray breathing on the viewbox: a soft-tissue grey torso, two radiolucent lung fields, the bright mediastinal shadow with the heart bulging to the left, a stacked bony spine, and nine pairs of ribs arcing out from the costovertebral joints — the whole cage inflating and emptying on a slow respiratory cycle as ribs elevate and the diaphragm domes descend, offered as neutral film grey, warm bromide, a cool digital plate, or a blueprint of bone contours.

energy.doc: exposure / density gain — brightness of the whole plate

breath.doc: depth of respiration — how much the ribcage inflates and empties

hue.doc: film tint (only used by warm/cool/schematic looks)

x.doc: pan across the plate when magnified

y.doc: pan up/down the plate when magnified

style.doc: neutral film grey / warm bromide print / cool digital plate / blueprint of bone contours (schematic = bones only)
